title: HostServices
description: Online route (P15): the host's listening sockets (servers only) and running systemd services, sent to POST /v1/services after a scan when sha256 changed, and at least daily. Each report replaces the previous one. At most 256 KiB uncompressed.

sha256.description: Services digest of listeners and services (contract, "Services digest"); compared for equality only.

owners.description: complete: the agent could read every process's sockets (the opt-in capability) and named an owner wherever one exists; partial: some or all owners are not visible (no capability, or the walk was capped), so a listener without service/program may still have one.

unit.description: A systemd unit name, e.g. nginx.service.

program.description: A process's short name (its comm, at most 15 bytes on Linux).

address.description: The bound IPv4 or IPv6 address, as the kernel reports it (0.0.0.0 and :: for any).

exposed.description: Bound to a non-loopback address (not whether a firewall lets it through).

service.description: The owning systemd unit; absent when the agent cannot see the owner.

program.description: The owning process's short name; absent when the agent cannot see the owner.

programs.description: Distinct short names of its processes, sorted, at most 16.

user.description: The user its main process runs as (a name, or the uid when it has none).
